literal: Resulting profit having coveted, blameworthy deeds they will not do, lack of impartiality those who are ashamed of.
translation: Those who are ashamed of being unjust will not commit blameworthy deeds out of a desire for the resulting profit.
modern: நடுவுநிலைமை தவறுவதற்கு வெட்கப்படுகின்றவர்கள், அதனால் கிடைக்கும் பெரும் பயனை விரும்பிப் பழியான செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet states that people who value fairness will never act unjustly, even if it brings them great wealth. The word 'நடுவன்மை' means the absence of impartiality or fairness. 'நாணுபவர்' refers to those who feel a deep sense of shame at the thought of losing their integrity. Therefore, they will not covet any 'படுபயன்' (resulting profit) that comes from doing 'பழிப்படுவ' (blameworthy deeds).
